rows.geographic_scope: Hanish Sill,Bab al Mandab; local exchange-flow interface
rows.temporal_scope: Source monthly profiles April-November1996; authors winter/summer labels, exact endpoint occupation month unresolved; not seasonal climatology or annual extrema.
rows.source_boundary_definition: Mean velocity zero crossing between inflowing Gulf of Aden water and deeper outflowing Red Sea water.
rows.source_velocity_profile_sampling_context: 10mvertical bins from10to130m; sourceextrapolated0/140/150m separately; no raw velocity reconstruction performed.
source_qualifications: Boundary of a monthly mean velocity profile, not mean individual interface depths.
Source season labels do not provide a recurring seasonal cycle or independent monthly observations.
No bottom or thickness from subtracting a sill/bathymetric/sampling depth.
Surface summer outflow is not the dense deeper overflow.
No exact station coordinates or route geometry from a named section.
